req.title: Community Engagement and Growth Lead
req.location: Remote — US or Europe (West Coast preferred)
req.seniority_band: Lead reporting to CEO; owns the community function end to end. JD explicitly states years of tenure do not matter — scored on ownership and results.
must_haves: Built or significantly expanded an online community
Lifecycle marketing that measurably changed user behavior with sustained effect
Worked at a consumer healthcare, wellness, or habit-change product
nice_to_haves: Turned user research into messaging or product change
Health and wellness micro-influencer relationships built through advocacy
Belief in or curiosity about hypnosis

candidates.name: Ashley Armenta
candidates.title: Ambassador Program Manager & Community Engagement Lead
candidates.calibration_question: Is an ambassador/advocacy program the right shape of 'community', or does the client mean a forum?

must_have_coverage.evidence: Built the Soluna Youth Ambassador Program end to end from side project to its own department; leads 18 ambassadors, 70+ statewide events, 50+ partner orgs. Kooth is a digital mental health provider running online peer-support communities. Lifecycle evidence is CRM-side: new CRM procedures driving a 40% increase in user adoption.

seniority_scope.evidence: Owns the program end to end — built all structures, policies, workflows and training; scaled it statewide and it is being replicated in New Jersey as a multi-state model.

domain_pedigree.evidence: Kooth Digital Health is the UK's largest digital mental health provider; Soluna is its youth app. Peer support and habit-forming engagement is the core product.

skill_depth.evidence: 15+ training modules and evaluation systems, 30% onboarding efficiency gain; CRM analytics via Totango and Airtable. Community-ops depth is strong; paid-acquisition depth is unevidenced.

location_authorization.evidence: Cottonwood, California — US and West Coast, matching the stated preference exactly.

trajectory_stability.evidence: 7.1 years total, 2.3 year average tenure; three internal moves at Kooth in roughly a year (CSM to Community Engagement Lead to Ambassador Program Manager).

candidates.name: Anthony Carrone
candidates.title: Director of Community Engagement
candidates.calibration_question: Does deep patient-community experience outweigh having no lifecycle-marketing half?

must_have_coverage.evidence: Seven years at Health Union (Associate Director then Director, Community Development) building online communities for chronic-condition patients; headline reads 'Driving Online Community Engagement'. No lifecycle-marketing or campaign-measurement evidence on the profile.

seniority_scope.evidence: Director, Community Development for three years after four as Associate Director — owned the community function at Health Union.

domain_pedigree.evidence: Health Union operates online communities for people living with chronic conditions — the closest population match to Reveri's chronic-pain users in the slate.

skill_depth.evidence: Skills list includes Applied Behavior Analysis and Campaign Development alongside brand and analytics.

location_authorization.evidence: North Carolina — US and remote-eligible, but not the preferred West Coast.

trajectory_stability.evidence: Seven continuous years at Health Union with one promotion, then moved to Life Science Connect in Oct 2025.

candidates.name: Heather Skaljac
candidates.title: Director of Lifecycle Marketing
candidates.calibration_question: Chronic-pain domain is the closest in the slate — does that offset three short recent tenures?

must_have_coverage.evidence: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager at SWORD Health for two years, then Director of Marketing at Moving Analytics and Director of Lifecycle at OneImaging. Lifecycle and domain are both covered; no online-community evidence.

seniority_scope.evidence: Director-level ownership of lifecycle at two companies in succession.

domain_pedigree.evidence: SWORD Health is digital musculoskeletal and chronic pain care; Moving Analytics is cardiac rehab behavior change. The nearest domain match in the slate to Reveri's chronic-pain product.

skill_depth.evidence: Lifecycle and CRM through 16 years, spanning B2B and B2C.

location_authorization.evidence: San Diego — US and West Coast.

trajectory_stability.evidence: SWORD 2.2 years, Moving Analytics 0.8 years, OneImaging 0.5 years — three moves in under four years.

candidates.name: Nicole Fitzgerald
candidates.title: Director of Lifecycle Marketing

must_have_coverage.evidence: Headline reads 'Director, Lifecycle Marketing & CRM | Customer Engagement, Retention & Growth' at a consumer fitness-habit app; promoted from Senior Marketing Manager. No online-community-building evidence.

seniority_scope.evidence: Owns lifecycle and CRM as Director at The Sculpt Society, promoted internally after 3.7 years.

domain_pedigree.evidence: The Sculpt Society is a consumer fitness-habit subscription app — the 'help people keep doing the thing' mandate the JD names.

skill_depth.evidence: Retention and engagement named explicitly in the headline; prior lifecycle role at Madison Reed.

location_authorization.evidence: Long Beach — US and West Coast.

trajectory_stability.evidence: 3.7 years at The Sculpt Society with a promotion to Director.

candidates.name: Kate Mallow
candidates.title: Community Manager
candidates.calibration_question: Purest community-plus-domain match in the slate, but has never owned a function — is that disqualifying?

must_have_coverage.evidence: Community Manager at Wisdo, a peer-support mental health community app, since Mar 2024; Associate Community Manager at Weight Watchers for 3.2 years before that. Community and domain both covered; no lifecycle-marketing evidence.

seniority_scope.evidence: Community Manager and Associate Community Manager titles — has executed within a community function, with no evidence of owning or defining one.

domain_pedigree.evidence: Wisdo is mental-health peer support; Weight Watchers is the canonical habit-change community product.

skill_depth.evidence: Community Management plus Crisis Counselling — directly relevant to the JD's requirement to hold sensitive health topics with empathy.

trajectory_stability.evidence: Weight Watchers 3.2 years, Wisdo 2+ years and current.

domain_pedigree.evidence: AllTrails is a consumer habit product with a large community, but not a healthcare, wellness or clinical product.
